title: Amount sent in cents
fix: Divide the amount by 100 before sending it, so it's in the currency's main unit.

title: Sale never reached the platform
fix: Add server-to-server reporting from the store's backend, which doesn't depend on the shopper's browser.

title: Click ID lost before checkout
fix: Keep the clickid parameter on every redirect, and save it in a first-party cookie or local storage on the first page the shopper sees.

title: Refunds not reported
fix: Call the reversal endpoint whenever an order is fully or partly refunded.

title: Wrong currency sent
fix: Send the order's own currency code on every conversion.

title: Test orders sent to production
fix: Use the test key while testing, and skip reporting for orders marked as tests.

title: Requests rejected by the API
fix: Correct the field named in the error and resend.

title: Tag fires more than once
fix: Always send the real order_id so the platform can drop duplicates, and fire the tag only once per order.

title: Sale outside the lookback window
fix: Nothing is broken. If the brand wants to credit longer journeys, the lookback window can be changed in the program settings.
